description: Fondazione IPRES publishes puglia service centres and road travel-time accessibility classes. Municipalities are classified as service centres where healthcare, education and mobility services are jointly available. Other municipalities are grouped by effective road travel-time distance into belt, intermediate, peripheral and ultraperipheral classes. ISTAT supplies the classification. No raw routing matrix, numerical class thresholds or facility geometry is established by the inspected metadata. Coverage is the Puglia region of Italy. The native catalogue provides CSV and spreadsheet distributions, with some linked visualisations. These alternative representations remain one resource; file contents and data rows were not inspected. The native licence is Creative Commons Attribution without a stated version. The national metadata mirror specifies version 4.0; the native statement remains unversioned. Metadata access is public, while file-use charges and restrictions are not established. Completeness and numerical accuracy are unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned. Related national and regional catalogue representations are treated as the same publication only where their exact source identities match.
